Yellow.flavor: Thick-necked meat that will not fall over. Hits like a slammed door and shrugs off the ones you land back.

Red.flavor: All legs and panic. Blink and it's already gone — or already biting.

Blue.flavor: Skinny thing with a reach like a fishing pole. Get inside that reach and it folds.

Purple.flavor: Nothing special about it, except that it's already behind you.

Grey.flavor: Doesn't have a specialty because it doesn't need one. Toughest common meal on the menu.

prairies.name: Fieldloaf
prairies.flavor: A pale lump that eats grass and screams if you look at it. Free lunch.

wetlands.name: Mudpuff
wetlands.flavor: Bobs in the shallows like a fat pale cloud. Runs slower than guilt.

mountains.name: Snowlump
mountains.flavor: White as the rock it hides against. Not hiding well.

beach.name: Tideblob
beach.flavor: Washes up, waddles off, gets eaten. The circle is short.

volcanic.name: Ashgrub
volcanic.flavor: Pale meat that survives the heat by being too dumb to notice it.

Yellow.name: Slabjaw
Yellow.flavor: Ripped off something that would not lie down. Bolted on, it keeps you upright a beat longer than you deserve.

Red.name: Bloodspur
Red.flavor: Faster than anything with this many teeth has any right to be. Bites first, never apologizes.

Blue.name: Farshank
Blue.flavor: Reaches you before you're ready to reach back. The distance was never yours to begin with.

Purple.name: Backbiter
Purple.flavor: You never see the one that gets you. Neither did this thing's last meal.

Grey.name: Greybrute
Grey.flavor: Good at every part of killing you. Rare, because most things this good don't share a biome with anything else for long.

Fins.name: Gillbrute
Fins.flavor: Owns the hollow like a landlord with teeth. Rip the gills off and wear the water yourself.

Claws.name: Ridgeripper
Claws.flavor: Holds the rocks like they're personal property. Pry the hooks loose and the cliffs are yours.

Coat.name: Frostpelt
Coat.flavor: Matted, mean, and unbothered by cold that kills everything else up here. Skin it and borrow the immunity.

Heat.name: Cinderjaw
Heat.flavor: Lives in the vents like they're a warm bath. Tear off the glowing seam and the lava stops being a wall.

apex.name: The Last Grey
apex.flavor: Woke up because you wouldn't stop eating. Doesn't run. Never has to.
